about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Automacake! Follow TOM, a small logistics automaton with a passion for baking, but who for some reason is physically unable to cook. Embark with him on his journey to Cake Island, a former foodie paradise, in search of the secret of cooking.

Unfortunately, Cake Island no longer attracts as many tourists as it once did, and the island only has a few residents and a precarious supply and infrastructure network. This is where your skills as a Logistics Automaton have room to shine, and can revive the charm that this gastronomic hub once had, bringing in new customers and, most importantly, new Chefs to put this delicious island back on the map!

Explore

Explore Cake Island for resources and secrets, both on the main island and in the surrounding archipelago.

Unlock new locations on the map as you progress through various tasks!

Interact

Make friends with the different people who move to the island and learn their stories!

Complete tasks and schedule deliveries of supplies to restaurants!

Build

Use the materials you obtain to build houses, unique structures, and decorations for Cake Island!

Contribute to community projects and help the residents restore the island's infrastructure.

Process your materials and the ingredients you produce to fulfill a variety of purposes.

Customize

Design the town to accommodate all the new residents and their specific needs!

Build a large automation chain to move, process, and store your materials and ingredients.

Become a true Chef

Discover, through different accounts of the legendary pastry chef Valentine Bleu, the true principles of cooking and dare to become a Chef, challenging your limits!
